column1: 4. Back-solve — What HBM OPM Would Consensus Require?
Note: Row 26 exposes the hidden premise in consensus. The unstated assumption about how far HBM margins rise becomes visible here.
Note: If the required HBM OPM exceeds 100%, or sits far above commodity OPM, consensus is not compatible with the current mix assumptions.
Note: Resolution point is the HBM4 annual contract price negotiation in Nov-Dec 2026 (Goldman +44-50% vs consensus +34%).
Warning: The row 26 back-solve implies an FY2027 commodity OPM above 99%. Either the consensus FY2027 EBIT margin of 82.3% is too high, or the HBM OPM assumption is too low.
Note: Holding commodity OPM flat pushes the FY2029 achievement rate above 100%, making the model more optimistic than consensus. The cycle turn must be entered year by year.
(17) ASP Drivers — Deriving OPM Instead of Entering It (added 2026-07-31)
HBM OPM is no longer entered directly. When the HBM contract ASP rises, OPM rises with it. Under a fixed-cost structure unit cost is unchanged, so the ASP move flows straight into margin.
